Preserve unrelated tactical decisions unless a connected adjustment is required; list and justify each connected change.
Recheck SP, DP, tile, deployment slot, skill timing and role gaps after the change; moving one timestamp alone is not complete repair.
Do not replace the concrete conflict with a vague conditional future-deploy claim.
Make the first observable tied to opening support or survival before the known early danger window, not merely a legal deployment.
